name: OpenMediaVault
description: Shows an OpenMediaVault NAS (version 6, 7 or 8) as a host with its Docker containers (from the openmediavault-compose plugin) and its virtual machines (from the openmediavault-kvm plugin) as guests: state, health, image and the ports containers publish, matched to the devices on your network. Reads through OpenMediaVault's own web interface API, read-only.
author: Netlens
supports: OpenMediaVault 8.5 with openmediavault-compose (tested on a real system)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
